title: Croatian Burger Delight
description: A twist on the classic burger, featuring a flavorful Croatian sausage and topped with a crispy fried egg.

ingredients.name: Aerated cheese
ingredients.notes: such as a light Swiss or mozzarella

instructions: 1. Preheat a grill or grill pan to medium-high heat.
2. Cook the Croatian sausage for 5-7 minutes per side, or until browned and cooked through.
3. Grill the burger patties for 4-5 minutes per side, or until cooked to your desired level of doneness.
4. Assemble the burgers with the cooked sausage, patties, lettuce, tomato, onion, pickles, and mayonnaise.
5. Meanwhile, fry the eggs in a skillet over medium heat until the whites are set and the yolks are cooked to your desired doneness.
6. Place a fried egg on top of each burger.
7. Serve the Croatian Burger Delight immediately and enjoy!
8. Offer additional toppings such as cheese, bacon, or caramelized onions.
9. Consider serving with a side of fries or a salad.
